in_marathi.name: Kanji
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanji हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kanji is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Kan' meaning 'Lord' and 'Ji' meaning 'Gods'. This name represents the supreme deity in Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva, who is the ruler of all gods. It is a powerful and spiritual name, evoking feelings of strength, power, and divinity.
